summary: This study looks at how a drug called an SGLT2 inhibitor affects aging cells in people with heart conditions or type 2 diabetes. Researchers want to see if the medication changes markers of cellular senescence, which is when cells stop dividing and aging. The study includes 92 participants who are split into groups taking different drugs like SGLT2 inhibitors or glimepiride. Yonsei University is sponsoring this clinical trial.
